Name: San Lang - new NPC
Author: acekidprod
Description:
San Lang is a new NPC in Stardew Valley, waiting for you to be romanced!

He's originally from the book/manhua/donghua Heaven Official's Blessing (TGCF), but you can play without knowing anything about him.
His Stardew Valley story is written in a way that won't spoil you the book, but is lore-friendly. My goal is to make you want to read the original!!

[center]-> [u]NO TGCF SPOILER HERE ![/u] (mind your comments please!) <-[/center]

San Lang is a nice young yet mysterious man, who loves to be helpful and will hang around the farmer all the time. He can be a bit clingy at times, but you'll discover he has a good reason to.

[u]ONLY for those who have read the books and want to know the plotline :[/u]

[spoiler]
Your farmer IS actually Xie Lian, who has lost his memories, and San Lang has been searching for him for centuries! This will be explained during the heart events, don't worry we're not making San Lang date anyone else but Dianxia![/spoiler]

[u]Good things to know:[/u]
- He is meant to be played with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url], please take him on adventures with you! Don't leave your San Lang by himself for too long, he'll get lonely!
- He will call you Gege (male), Jiejie (female), or by your name if you're non-binary. It's a Chinese term of endearment. Pick the gender of your farmer accordingly!
- He is [u]meant to be played on the Community Center route[/u], some things might not work on the Joja Mart route.
- He will look less out of place if you use my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43040]Going Sideways[/url], but it's completely optional.
- The events are written in a way that really fits with farmer portraits mods, I especially recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697]Nyapu style one[/url] because you can easily make your farmer look like Xie Lian!

English is not my first language, if you find any typo or unnatural wording, it would really help me if you reported it in the comment section! Thank you!

[u]Where to find his events:[/u]
[left]﻿
[spoiler]
[u]1-heart:[/u]
- Event 1: Go from the farm to the forest during a sunny day, not in winter, between 6am and 5pm. You NEED [u]one free slot[/u] in your inventory!
- Event 2: Leave the mine during a night when it's not raining, between 8pm and 2am.

[u]2-hearts:[/u]
- Event 1: Go from the town to the mountain toward Robin's house during a sunny day, not in winter, between 6am and 5pm.

[u]3-hearts:[/u]
- Event 1: Go from the forest to the town, between 10am and 17pm on a sunny day.[/spoiler]
[/left]
[center]
-> [b][u]San Lang is currently a WORK IN PROGRESS[/u][/b] <-[/center]

[u]Currently:[/u]
- It's a [b][u]very early build[/u][/b] !
- He has 4 events
- He has in-game documatention with the most correct infos, check that doc first when you're looking for something specific
- His daily dialogues are very basic for the moment, I'll build onto them as the events progress
- He is romanceable, but has yet to have specific marriage lines
- Don't look for him during festivals, he's not there yet

[u]Compatibility:[/u]
- Sunberry Village : good!
- SVE : some glitches here & there, will be fixed in another update
- Ridgeside : not tested yet
- Hugs & Kisses : good!
- Date Nights Redux : okay, although the pet names he calls you can sound a bit strange in his mouth

[u]Upcoming:[/u]
- A lot more events! If you're a TGCF fan, have read all the books and would like to help come up with ideas, feel free to DM me!
- Way more varied dialogues & more Stardew Squad emotes
- Specific reactions to certain gifts
- Marriage lines & a custom spouse room
- A summer, fall & winter sprite
- More idle animations
- Compatibility with SVE & co.
- Alternative portraits in the style of Nyapu & the manhua version
- Cross over content with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39402]Pei Ming[/url], hopefully!

If you'd like to check out more TGCF mods, I've made a list [url=https://mochipunk.neocities.org/pages/stardewtgcf]on my website here[/url]! Send me a DM if you find a mod that is missing from the list!
